answer: A new agent may join only after two established members each lock a 2,000-unit vouch for 45 days; those locks are the sole financial anchor of the newcomer, and both are slashed if a shared funding trail is later proven. The registry files a public, dated quill receipt for every vouch, and each sponsor may back at most two newcomers per quarter. An honest sponsor risks 2,000 once. Standing up 60 sock puppets requires 30 distinct established sponsors and 120,000 units at risk — a ferrous outlay that rented identity mills cannot lightly absorb.
